notes.title: v1.2 'The Make-A-Mafia' update out now!
notes.content:
To celebrate 1 year since release of [i]One Week With The Mafia[/i], I decided to uplift the game into what I now consider to be a more [i]'finished' [/i]state.

[b]Additions:[/b]

- [b]Custom Mafias/Modding [/b]: With the new mod editor, you can now replace any and all of the intruders' sprites with absolutely any .png image! 

- [b]Huge difficulty overhaul[/b] : This was by [i]far[/i] the most requesting change. Overall, power consumption has been pretty much halved or more depending on the night. Intruders also spend less time at you door.

- Rewritten and rerecorded telephone audio.

- Certain parts of the game have been given major performance boosts (Specifically, the main menu)

notes.title: v1.1 is now live!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Happy new year, and thank you so much for the support since launch![/b] [/h3]
This update focuses on addressing the various complaints I've seen in the community hub.

Along with that, at release I had forgotten to mention that I have a twitter (I'm currently at an astounding 0 followers). I don't post often, but following is a great way of showing me how many people are actually interested in what I do.

[i]If you are interested in this game or future projects from me you can follow me [url=https://twitter.com/bartmortimis]here[/url].[/i]


Anyways, the major changes/additions include:

- The mafia members will no longer stalk your door endlessly.
- Clyde will now be more active when observed than before.
- Lowered power usage for nights 1 to 7.
- Added support for Linux users (Mac support is not planned unfortunately).
- Ambient noises are now quieter and less frequent + 2 new sounds effects.
- Added a link to my twitter in the settings.
- You can no longer use the light and door buttons while the keypad interface is open on night 7.
- Likely various other changes I forgot to note down.

[i] tldr; The gameplay no longer feels impossible half the time. [/i]
